stub_is_not_a_constant_function.why: the stubbed feature table is all zeros, so a stub that ignored the features would reproduce the real pass exactly; a NON-zero difference is the evidence that the real pass actually reads the features. This cell FAILS if the difference is zero.

frozen_replay_is_bitwise.note: featurize-once, then replay the SAME feature through the frozen path

stale_memo_probe.protocol: eval (fills the memo) -> one AdamW step -> clear the memo -> eval

stale_memo_probe_no_clear.protocol: eval (fills the memo) -> one AdamW step -> eval WITHOUT clearing
stale_memo_probe_no_clear.note: a non-zero difference is the content-keyed memo serving a STALE H_Q/H_C after an in-place weight change it cannot observe. It is a property of the shipped memo (it is keyed on content, not on weights), not something this benchmark introduced.
